text:
maria: noticing a surge of failed SCIM provisioning + SAML assertion expirations from Azure AD App Proxy around 6180001111. lots of 429s and KMS decrypt errors. anyone on identity? :eyes:
raj: which env and any deploys around then? can you paste the logs + correlation id?
maria: prod. snippet: `2026-03-23T15:12:30Z idp-proxy: saml validation failed: assertion expired (issued 2026-03-23T15:12:21Z, not_on_or_after 2026-03-23T15:12:31Z)`
kevin: that's a 10s window again. Wasn't that pilot TTL? Did a feature-flag slip?
ops-bot: deploy identity/app-proxy v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3 by @maria at 2026-03-22T23:10:05Z :white_check_mark:
elaine: KMS logs show `Decrypt Failed: NotFound` for alias alias/redwood-prod-main during the same window. could be alias swap in-flight.
sre-oncall: checking host clock on proxy-02/03: `chronyc tracking` showed small jitter up to 4s at 15:12:28 but stable afterwards.
maria: full log excerpt: 
```
[15:12:21] azure: assertion issue_time=2026-03-23T15:12:21Z not_on_or_after=2026-03-23T15:12:31Z
[15:12:24] proxy-03 current_time=2026-03-23T15:12:25Z validation failed: now > not_on_or_after? (diff ~ -6s)
[15:12:25] scim POST /provision -> 429 rate_limit
[15:12:26] kms decrypt err key_alias=alias/redwood-prod-main: NotFound
```
raj: hypothesis: three-way race: 1) an accidental pilot flag caused 10s assertion TTL to be used in prod, 2) KMS alias rotation happened mid-rolling restart leaving alias briefly unresolvable, 3) tiny clock jitter on one proxy node made short TTL assertions fail. combined -> provisioning backlog and 429s.
kevin: agree. mitigation? rollback proxy and pause key rotation?
maria: rolled back to v3.4.2 on proxy-01/02 and paused the rotation. also increased SCIM retry/backoff and enabled a provisioning whitelist to reduce customer impact.
elaine: action items: 1) restrict pilot TTL flags from reaching prod via gating; 2) add an alert when assertion TTL < 30s; 3) block KMS alias state transitions during rolling restarts (ops playbook); 4) export KMS rotation timeline for compliance audit.
raj: please attach describe-key outputs and CloudTrail entries for the rotation window so we can annotate the incident. I’ll help with the compliance writeup.
security-bot: INC-2026-0423 created, severity P1. runbook linked.
maria: opening PRs for guardrails + runbook updates, and filing a support ticket with Azure to confirm assertion TTL source. tagging @elaine @raj for audit notes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
